text: We are open Monday to Friday 8am to 6pm and Saturday 9am to 2pm. We are closed on Sundays.
You can cancel or reschedule free of charge up to 24 hours before your clean. Cancellations inside 24 hours may be charged half the booked price.
A regular clean covers dusting, vacuuming and mopping all floors, wiping kitchen surfaces and appliance exteriors, cleaning bathrooms and emptying bins.
A deep clean covers everything in a regular clean plus inside the fridge, baseboards, door frames, window sills, light fittings and heavy build-up in kitchens and bathrooms.
An oven clean covers the oven interior, racks, trays and door glass. It is booked as an add-on or on its own.
